Product Description

The Belgrave Mango Wood Dining Table brings understated elegance to dining spaces. Its round top rests on a fluted pedestal base, crafted from mango wood in a luxurious walnut finish. Designed to seat four, it’s perfectly sized for intimate meals and smaller gatherings. A versatile piece, Belgrave works across contemporary, coastal, French, and tropical interiors.

Please Note: Before placing your order, we recommend measuring your space — including doorways, staircases, and hallways — to ensure your new dining table can be delivered with ease. For extra reassurance, our optional Room of Choice (ROC) delivery service is available. Larger pieces can be difficult to handle alone, and our team makes the process simple and stress-free at an affordable rate.

Care & Buying Guide

Care Guide

Dust your dining table regularly with a soft, dry cloth, using a lightly dampened one only when needed. Keep it away from direct sunlight, heat, and moisture to prevent fading or warping. Always use coasters, placemats, and trivets under hot or cold items to protect the surface, and lift décor rather than dragging it. Check fittings occasionally to keep the table steady and secure.

Buying Guide

Our dining tables often feature natural materials like wood, stone, or marble, so subtle variations in grain, colour, and texture are completely normal. Colours may also appear slightly different depending on lighting or screen settings. These natural differences aren’t flaws. They’re what make each FableRoom piece feel unique, crafted with care, and made to last.

Everything You Need To Know

Is the Belgrave dining table good for small dining spaces?

Yes, its round 120 cm design is ideal for compact dining areas and intimate meals.

What makes the Belgrave table’s base distinctive?

Its fluted pedestal base adds an elegant architectural detail to the dining room.

Can four people sit comfortably at the Belgrave table?

Yes, the round tabletop is designed to comfortably seat up to four people.

What dining styles suit the Belgrave table?

Its walnut finish works beautifully with contemporary, coastal, French, and tropical interiors.

How should the Belgrave mango wood table be cared for?

Use a soft cloth and protect the surface with coasters, placemats, and trivets.

Why are pedestal dining tables becoming popular?

A pedestal base creates a clean, open look and gives diners more legroom around the table.

Does a round dining table make a room feel more inviting?

Yes, its curved shape creates a relaxed atmosphere and makes it easier for everyone to interact.

Is walnut furniture easy to style?

Yes, walnut tones pair beautifully with cream, beige, white, black, and natural textures.

What lighting works best above a round dining table?

A pendant or rounded light fixture centred above the table can create a balanced and welcoming focal point.

Can a round dining table be used for more than meals?

Absolutely. It can provide a practical space for coffee, games, conversations, or casual gatherings.
